verdicts.reason: The two are nearly identical. In both, the headline wraps with 'Sunday' alone on the last line, the date and address lines sit jammed under the headline and right-aligned against a left-aligned headline, the cross's white crossbar no longer spans the window cleanly, and the bottom third of the canvas is empty dead space. B is slightly worse: its headline starts about 12px from the left edge and its address line runs almost to the right edge, so its margins are cramped. A keeps somewhat more breathing room.
